text: Sport plays a huge part in cultures all over the world. Every four years, millions of spectators watch athletes compete in major tournaments such as the Olympic Games, where nations gather to see who can achieve the greatest victory. Although winning a championship brings fame and money, many athletes say that discipline and determination matter more than any medal. Behind every victory lies years of hard work. Athletes train for hours every day to build the strength and endurance needed to defeat a strong opponent. A good coach also knows how to motivate players, especially when a team is considered the underdog and is not expected to win. Teamwork, too, is essential: even the most talented player cannot win alone. Sport is not only about competition, however. Sportsmanship, which means treating your opponent with respect whether you win or lose, is considered just as important as skill. Fans express their support by cheering loudly for their favourite team, and a fierce rivalry between two clubs can create an exciting atmosphere. Whether an athlete breaks a world record or simply finishes a race, sport continues to inspire people of every age.
